verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs describe reverse-ETL sync, CDC that only sends changed rows, and event collection/storage, but there is no evidence of a replay/backfill mechanism to reprocess archived events into a new destination or backfill history after adding a tool or fixing a broken pipeline. missing for 10: any documentation of event/archive replay, historical backfill runs, or reprocessing past syncs into new destinations.
